title.narrative: Air Quality Improvement in the Greater Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei Region—Regional Emission-Reduction and Pollution-Control Facility

description.narrative: The proposed project is the third in a multiyear, multisector Asian Development Bank (ADB) support program for air quality improvement in the greater Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei (BTH) region. The first loan, approved in 2015, focused on reforming policy and strengthening regulatory capacity in Hebei province. The second loan, approved in 2016, targeted better access to finance, especially for small and medium sized-enterprises, to scale up investments in pollution-reduction projects in the region. This third project will complement the previous projects and will directly help remove barriers to deploying high technologies that could reduce air pollution from industries, urban infrastructure, and agriculture.

Progress Toward Outcome: No new fund was established for the period Jan-Jun 2023. According to SASAC limit, establishing new funds by central state-owned enterprises is temporarily suspended. Thus, there's no schedule for fund registration although negotiations for cooperation are underway.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jul 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51181/51181-001-apfs-en_4.pdf
Some results are in the Environment and Social Management System Arrangements | Oct 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51181/51181-001-esms-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental and Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51181/51181-001-esmr-en_9.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Sep 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51181/51181-001-iee-en_1.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The establishment of the facility and various funds have been established since June 2019, with the latest fund established in November 2021 (Bohua Industry Fund).The facility (CECEP ADB Industry Investment Fund) was established on 14 June 2019.The Regional Fund (CECEP ADB Weilan Industry Investment Fund) was established on 31 December 2019.The Local Fund (CECEP ADB Jinxin Equity Investment Fund) was established in August 2020.The Technology- or Industry-Specific Fund (Bohua Industry Fund) was established in November 2021.
The project has approved and funded 18 subprojects, of which 11 were funded directly by ADB loan proceeds and 7 by reflow/recycle fund. In 2022, four subprojects were approved - (i) two by reflow fund - Photovoltaic Generation Subproject in Gansu Province and Wuwei City, and Shanghai Green Building Construction Subprojects; and (ii) two by ADB loan proceeds (Subloan 13: Shouguang Changxu Waste Heating Subproject and Subloan 14: Beijing Daxing Smart, Green and Energy-Efficient Complex Subproject).
Various trainings, workshops, and webinars in areas such as high technology, selection of appropriate business models, investment decision-making, and ESMS implementation have been held for the Project since its launch. By December of 2022, more than 200 individuals have benefitted from the trainings, workshops, and webinars conducted. The stakeholders include PMO, members at CECEP and CECEP Fund, environmental and social specialists at CECEP Hundred and CECEPEC, project managers and financial managers from sub-borrowers, investment managers from co-financers, professionals from cooperative entrusted banks and account banks, officials from local government investment platforms, etc. CECEP Fund has prepared and disseminated the guidelines on the selection, appraisal, and implementation of subprojects , including investment management implementation rules and risk management implementation rules for ADB-funded projects in 2020.
The project has completed: (i) three biogas and/or hydrogen production facilities were constructed--a) Tianjin Dongli Biomasss Energy and Comprehensive Waste Treatment Subprojects (biogas production) implemented in 2020, (b) Shandong Jimo Kitchen Waste-to-Biogas ad Recycled Utilization Subprojects (Biogas production) implemented in 2021; (c) Energy conservation, emission, reduction and utilization of waste heat and hydrogen Project in Bohua Chemical Industry Park (hydrogen product) implemented in 2021; (ii) ywo biogas production facilities were constructed-(a) Tianjin Dongli Biomass Energy and Comprehensive Waste Treatment Subproject implemented in 2020; and (b) Shandong Jimo Kitchen Waste-to-Biogas and Recycled Utilization Subproject implemented in 2021; (iii) two smart micro-grids constructed in industrial parks--(a) Tianjin Dongli Biomass Energy and Comprehensive Waste Treatment Subproject implemented in 2020; (b) Energy Conservation, Emission Reduction and Utilization of Waste Heat and Hydrogen Project in Bohua Chemical Industry Park implemented in 2021; (iv) heat-pumped based subprojects--Jiaozhou City Shaoni New City Sewage Heat Pump Heating/Cooling Subproject, which was implemented in 2021 and provided heat-pump based district heating to 2.45 million square meters of floor area; and (v) energy efficiency measure in heavily polluting and high energy consuming industries subprojects:(a) China Great Wall Aluminum Cooperation Waste Heat Utilization District Heating Subproject implemented in 2019; (b) Shouguang City Power Plant Waste Heat Utilization District Heating Subproject implemented in 2020; (c) Hebei Yu County Residual Heat Utilization and Emission Reduction Subproject implemented in 2021; (d) Hebei Xingtang Residual Heat Utilization and Emission Reduction Subproject implemented in 2021; and (e) Energy Conservation, Emission Reduction and Utilization of Waste Heat and Hydrogen Project in Bohua Chemical Industry Park implemented in 2021.
